protocol.constraints: All team-strength and home-field coefficients nonnegative; rest unconstrained. No intercept. Neutral strength is scalar and transitive.
protocol.selection: Minimum pooled previous-three-year log loss. Inner-year fits train only on preceding years from 2019. Refit through outerYear-1.
protocol.calendarDecay: Recruiting in all_calendar multiplied by exp(-completed calendar weeks/6), never opponent sample count.
protocol.scope: Retrospective revised historical data; all evaluation years have been inspected previously. EPA upstream fitting may include later data. No pristine holdout or verified garbage-time-filter claim.
